trans-unit.source: Heya, <Mint>. I want you to teach me how to cook.
trans-unit.target: Heya, <Mint>. I want you to teach me how to cook.

trans-unit.source: You can't? I dunno what to do, 'cause I screw it up all the time. It's getting so old.
trans-unit.target: You can't? I dunno what to do, 'cause I screw it up all the time. It's getting so old.

trans-unit.source: Don't stress on it. Everyone has their strong and weak points, so--
trans-unit.target: Don't stress on it. Everyone has their strong and weak points, so--

trans-unit.source: Yes, that's right! I think you should just keep at what you do best.
trans-unit.target: Yes, that's right! I think you should just keep at what you do best.

trans-unit.source: Mmm... If that's what you think, I guess that's what I'll do. Thanks!
